message.liteminer_delta.insufficient_hun: Not enough hunger to vein mine.
liteminer_delta.configuration.title: Liteminer Delta Configuration
liteminer_delta.config.key_mode.tooltip: In Hold mode you must keep holding the key to mine. In toggle mode you have to hit the key to toggle.
liteminer_delta.config.show_hud.tooltip: Enables the text showing how many blocks you have selected and your mining shape.
liteminer_delta.config.hud_scale.tooltip: Changes how big the HUD elements are.
liteminer_delta.config.distinguish_deeps: Prevents regular and deepslate variants of the same ore from being vein mined together.
liteminer_delta.config.distinguish_stone: Prevents blocks in the same base stone tag, such as stone, granite, diorite, and andesite, from being vein mined together.
liteminer_delta.config.block_break_limit: Upper limit to how many blocks can be broken at a time.
liteminer_delta.config.require_correct_t: If enabled, blocks can only be broken if holding the correct tool.
liteminer_delta.config.harvest_time_per_: Increases the time it takes to break a block when vein mining.
Modifier used to scale up the time it needs to mine a block. Higher values mean longer times to mine.
liteminer_delta.config.food_exhaustion_e: Causes your hunger to go down per block mined.
liteminer_delta.config.food_exhaustion.t: How much food exhaustion to cause per block broken.
liteminer_delta.config.allow_vein_mining: Allow Vein Mining at Zero Hunger
Allows vein mining when the hunger bar is empty.
liteminer_delta.config.prevent_tool_brea: Stops vein mining when the durability of the tool gets to 1.
